chip.description: Tilemap generator: four ROM-sourced 16x16 background layers with zoom and rowscroll (two also with per-row zoom and column scroll) plus a RAM-sourced 8x8 text layer, mixed on-die into a 16-bit pixel stream (taxonomy §4.18 example).
chip.notes: src/mame/taito/tc0480scp.cpp in MAME 0.288, whose pin list is taken from the Gunbuster schematics.
